title: Verify Sorter Queue Flow: Entrance Queue → Queue Locations → Sorter Queue Locations → Exit Queue (and Shutdown Queues)
summary: Use the documented sorter queue layout to verify that AGVs/totes follow the expected queue sequence: entrance queue first, then queue locations for staging behind for an exchange, then sorter queue locations for tote pickup and leaving into the aisle, then exit queue after an exchange. Also verify shutdown queue destinations under the rack, including the tote-dependent split (AGVs without totes vs AGVs with totes) and the shutdown entry behavior (entrance during shutdown with a tote goes to “off the end” then shutdown).
when_to_use: When you need to understand or sanity-check where AGVs/totes should be staged and where they should go after an exchange, using the documented sorter queue layout and shutdown queue behavior.
not_for: Do not use this as a corrective procedure to change system routing or to perform AGV/tote removal/reassignment actions.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Use the documented queue layout to map observed AGV/tote movement to the expected entrance → staging → pickup/leave → exit sequence, and to the correct shutdown queue/off-the-end behavior based on tote presence.
access_or_tools_needed: Visual access to the sorter queue layout areas: entrance queue, queue locations, sorter queue locations, exit queue, shutdown queues (under the rack), and the “off the end” area.

visual_references.description: Sorter layout frame showing entrance queue, queue locations (AGV staging behind for exchange), sorter queue locations (tote pickup and leaving into the aisle), exit queue (after exchange), and shutdown queues under the rack including tote/no-tote split and the shutdown entry path via “off the end”.

steps.title: Confirm the entrance queue rule (anything entering must go to entrance queue first)
steps.purpose: Verify the documented first-step routing rule for items/AGVs entering the sorter area.
steps.instruction: Using the documented rule, confirm that anything that wants to go into this sorter area must go to the entrance queue first.

steps.healthy_condition: The rule is consistent with the entrance queue label on the same layout frame.
steps.failure_condition: Observed movement suggests bypassing the entrance queue rule (e.g., entering the sorter area without first being at the entrance queue).

steps.title: After an exchange, confirm the next destination is the exit queue
steps.purpose: Verify the documented post-exchange routing destination.
steps.instruction: Using the documented rule, confirm that once you do an exchange, it must go to the exit queue (described as where it leaves before it could go to anywhere else it wants to go for shutdown).
steps.expected_result: You can confirm the rule: exchange → exit queue.
steps.healthy_condition: The exit queue is identified on the layout frame and the exchange-to-exit rule is consistent with it.
steps.failure_condition: Observed movement after an exchange does not go to the exit queue.

steps.title: Locate the shutdown queues under the rack and identify the tote-dependent split (with totes vs without totes)
steps.purpose: Verify correct shutdown queue destination based on whether the AGV has a tote.
steps.instruction: On the sorter layout, locate the shutdown queues under the rack and identify the documented split: locations for AGVs without totes vs the location for AGVs with totes.
steps.expected_result: You can identify the under-rack shutdown locations and distinguish the tote/no-tote destinations.
steps.healthy_condition: The layout frame shows shutdown queues under the rack and explicitly indicates which location is for AGVs with totes vs AGVs without totes.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot distinguish the tote-dependent shutdown destinations under the rack.

actions.label: Locate under-rack shutdown queues and tote split
actions.exact_action: Locate the shutdown queues area(s) under the rack and identify the documented tote-dependent split: shutdown positions for AGVs without totes vs a location for AGVs with totes.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “We have shutdown queues… these locations are under the rack… When you shut down, they move to shut down locations. So these locations are Agvs without Tots. This location is for Agvs with Tots.”

steps.title: If entering during shutdown with a tote, follow the documented off-the-end then shutdown path
steps.purpose: Verify the special shutdown entry behavior when a tote is present.
steps.instruction: If the system is in a shutdown state when entering the entrance and you have a tote, confirm the documented path: go to “off the end” and then go to the shutdown.
steps.expected_result: You can confirm the documented shutdown entry behavior for the tote-present case: entrance during shutdown + tote → off the end → shutdown.
steps.healthy_condition: The layout frame includes the “off the end” behavior and the shutdown destination is identifiable.
steps.failure_condition: Observed behavior during shutdown entry with a tote does not follow the off-the-end then shutdown path.

actions.label: Validate shutdown entry path (tote present)
actions.exact_action: If the system is in a shutdown state when entering the entrance and you have a tote, follow the documented path: go to “off the end” and then go to the shutdown.

stop_or_escalate_if: If observed movement does not align with the documented queue sequence (including incorrect shutdown destination for tote vs no-tote), stop and escalate for support rather than guessing corrective actions.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Also in a shutdown… we have a off the end. So if you come into the entrance and we're in a shutdown state and you have a tote, you go to off the end and then you go to the shutdown.”

success_criteria: You can map observed/expected AGV/tote movement to the documented queue sequence: entrance queue first, then queue locations for staging behind for an exchange, then sorter queue locations for tote pickup and leaving into the aisle, then exit queue after an exchange.
You can map shutdown behavior to the documented tote-dependent split under the rack (AGVs without totes vs AGVs with totes).
For shutdown entry with a tote, you can confirm the documented off-the-end then shutdown path.
healthy_conditions: AGVs/totes entering the sorter area follow the entrance queue first rule.
After staging behind for an exchange, the tote pickup/leave occurs at sorter queue locations.
After an exchange, the next destination is the exit queue.
During shutdown, AGVs without totes are directed to the under-rack shutdown locations for “without totes,” and AGVs with totes are directed to the tote location.
During shutdown entry with a tote, the path includes “off the end” before shutdown.
failure_conditions: Observed movement bypasses the entrance queue rule.
After an exchange, the AGV/tote does not go to the exit queue.
During shutdown, AGVs with totes and without totes are sent to the wrong shutdown destinations under the rack.
During shutdown entry with a tote, the AGV/tote does not follow the off-the-end then shutdown path.
escalation_guidance: If observed movement does not align with the documented queue sequence (e.g., bypassing entrance queue, not going to exit queue after exchange, or incorrect shutdown destination for tote vs no-tote), stop and escalate for support rather than guessing corrective actions.
